report_markdown:
**Suppliers for 316L tri-clamp sanitary fittings** (checked 2026-11-14)

EU manufacturing; ferrules, elbows and tees in 1.5–4 inch; approximately 5,000 pieces per quarter; ISO 9001 required. Two manufacturers are shortlisted: one documented full match and one conditional partial source. All evidence comes from the supplied test-page captures, not live websites. Likely HS family: 7307, subject to classification of the actual fittings.

| # | Supplier | Plants | Fit | Capacity | Certifications | Risks | Contact |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Inoxval S.r.l.](https://www.inoxval.example/en/sanitary-fittings) | Brescia, Italy | Exact: stated material, fitting types and size range cover the request | Claimed: >40,000 pieces/month; allocation and MOQ unknown | ISO 9001:2015 IT-23881: verified in supplied [registry capture](https://www.iafcertsearch.example/search?q=Inoxval), valid to 2028-03-31; EN 10204 3.1 documentation claimed on request | Manufacturing and capacity not independently corroborated; risk screening incomplete | sales@inoxval.example |
| 2 | [Hygitec GmbH](https://www.hygitec.example/products/clamp) | Bielefeld, Germany | Partial: published range ends at 2.5 inch; individual fitting types unconfirmed | Not stated | ISO 9001: unverified; supplied [registry search](https://www.iafcertsearch.example/search?q=Hygitec) found no certificate | Conditional source only; risk screening incomplete | hygitec.example/anfrage |

The Inoxval registry capture matches the supplier name and Brescia plant location. It supports the ISO status only; it does not independently establish product capability or production capacity. Hygitec's unsuccessful registry search does not establish that it lacks certification.

**Trade-offs:** Inoxval is the strongest full-range candidate. Hygitec may provide a partial second source but cannot presently be treated as covering the complete requirement. Claimed output is not a delivery commitment, and MOQ and lead times remain unknown.

**Ask in the RFQ:** Confirm SKU-level size coverage and drawings, interface standard, finish, quarterly allocation, MOQ, lead times, material certificates and traceability. Obtain Hygitec's ISO certificate and evidence for any larger-size offering.

**Near misses:** [ProClean Trade B.V.](https://www.procleantrade.example/fittings) identifies itself as a stockist/distributor and is excluded from the manufacturer shortlist.

**Evidence limits and next steps:** No independent product corroboration, ownership checks or sanctions/forced-labour/regulatory screening was available in the supplied captures. Complete those checks, confirm certificate scope, and approve samples and an audit before award. No suppliers were contacted.

_The ranking is a recommendation to confirm by RFQ and audit._
